# Example

The Uplink the Gonogo Uplink Guide builds: a heartbeat it publishes, a command that starts its count again, and a forward model that carries the count between samples.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Uplink id | `example` |
| Version | `0.0.1` |
| Built against | contract 44.8, extension API 6.0.0 |

## Install

Install the Example Uplink with CKAN: search for `GonogoExampleUplink`, tick it and apply. CKAN also installs Gonogo itself.

Without CKAN, download `GonogoExampleUplink.zip` from the releases page, unpack it into your Kerbal Space Program folder so that it lands in `GameData/GonogoExampleUplink`, and install Gonogo the same way.

Releases: https://github.com/ksp-gonogo/uplink-dev-docs/releases?q=example-v

## Widgets

### Heartbeat

How many samples the Example Uplink has published, and the game time of the latest one, carried forward between samples. Reset starts the count again.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Widget id | `example-heartbeat` |
| Reads | `example.heartbeat` |
| Default size, in grid units | 6 × 4 |
| Smallest size, in grid units | 5 × 4 |
| Scenes | 1 |
